subject: Request: executive approval for temporary billing ramp — Palisade Health
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Leduc <sophie.leduc@palisadehealth.com>; ap@palisadehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: executive approval for temporary billing ramp — Palisade Health

Hi Sophie / Palisade team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As discussed, Palisade is requesting a temporary move to quarterly invoicing (one consolidated invoice per quarter) for the first six months of the pilot, with the first invoice deferred to Net-90 from the start date because their initial procurement cycle is tied to an internal board review.

Key ask (from Palisade):
- Temporarily change invoicing cadence to quarterly for first 6 months
- First invoice payment terms: Net-90 (then revert to Net-30)
- No upfront prepayment for usage; they will provide PO and signing is imminent

Impact/what we need:
- This is outside standard policy — approving Net-90 exposes us to a collection risk and cash-flow hit; we would normally require prepay or shorter term.
- Palisade is a mid-market account with potential ARR ~$540k first year if we secure their five product teams.

Attachments: Palisade_MA_plan_v2.pdf (summary of rollout), Proposed_Amendment_v1.docx (redline we sent).

Sophie — want to put this through Deal Desk / Exec approval so we can finalize signatures this week. Marissa / Jonas — tagging you for routing to finance and exec sign-off. My recommendation: conditional approval for Net-90 limited to the first invoice only, require PO and Signed Amendment (DocuSign) before terms take effect, and add an early-pay incentive (1.5% if paid within 15 days).

Next step: can someone from Finance or Exec confirm whether we can approve this conditional Net-90 by Wednesday?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: Palisade_MA_plan_v2.pdf (64KB), Proposed_Amendment_v1.docx (28KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Leduc <sophie.leduc@palisadehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: executive approval for temporary billing ramp — Palisade Health

Alex — thanks for the context and the docs. A few quick concerns from Sales Ops:

- Exposure: Net-90 for the first invoice is tolerable if we get a signed amendment + PO up front, but I want Finance to confirm we can tolerate the delay without additional collateral.
- Precedent: Palisade is a reference customer; we need clear language limiting this to this account and timeframe to avoid setting a broad precedent.
- Pricing: Recommend we do NOT layer an additional discount. The early-pay incentive that Alex suggested sounds good (keeps us protected).

Jonas — can you escalate this to Naomi for decision? If Finance signs off on the conditional language (amendment + PO + limited to Q1 pilot), I think we can move quickly.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Leduc <sophie.leduc@palisadehealth.com>, ap@palisadehealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: executive approval for temporary billing ramp — Palisade Health

Naomi / Finance team — need quick exec decision here. Summary:
- Account: Palisade Health, potential ARR ~ $540k
- Ask: Quarterly invoicing for 6 months; first invoice Net-90
- Sales recommendation: Conditional approval for Net-90 only for the first invoice, contingent on: PO + signed amendment (DocuSign) prior to commencement; no changes to list price / no additional discounts; include 1.5% early-pay credit if payment received within 15 days.

Risks: cash flow and collections hit if payment delayed beyond Net-90; however Palisade has existing public funding and good references and this is a pilot that will likely expand.

Request: Naomi — can you confirm approval or provide alternative? If approved, ask Legal/Billing to prepare a one-paragraph amendment that limits this concession to the first invoice and adds the early-pay language. If Finance wants reserves or a short prepayment for professional services, call it out.

Jonas
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

> On Mon, Sep 27, 2026 at 12:40 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Alex — thanks for the context and the docs. A few quick concerns from Sales Ops...

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Leduc <sophie.leduc@palisadehealth.com>, ap@palisadehealth.com, billing@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: executive approval for temporary billing ramp — Palisade Health

Team — after reviewing the docs and projected ARR, Finance will APPROVE the requested temporary billing cadence with the following conditions (no exceptions beyond these):

1) Net-90 approval is limited to the FIRST invoice only (covers onboarding month). Subsequent invoices revert to standard Net-30 cadence unless a formal exception is approved by Finance.
2) We must receive a valid PO and a fully signed amendment (DocuSign) that includes the limited-term clause prior to the first invoice being issued.
3) No list-price discount is authorized. Do NOT offer a monetary discount as part of this concession.
4) We authorize a 1.5% early-pay credit if Palisade pays within 15 days of invoice. This is recorded as a credit memo, not a permanent price change.
5) Billing will add a clear clause that this concession is a one-time pilot approval and cannot be cited by other customers.

Naomi Feldman
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Sophie — we will have Billing prepare the amendment template and copy you on DocuSign. Please confirm PO timing so we can schedule the first invoice.

Attachments: HubSpot-PLS-2026-0042.html (deal snapshot)
